name: Advanced Power Electronics Laboratory
description: Single phase uncontrolled rectifier implementation with capacitive load, PWM signal generation using analogue circuits, implementation of low-side and high-side gate driver, implementation of half bridges in a buck/boost converter, switching loss characterization using double pulse test, design and implementation of inductor and its testing, implementation of buck/boost converter and testing of performance in buck and boost mode in CCM, testing of buck/boost converter in DCM, comparison of efficiencies in CCM and DCM, modification of buck/boost converters into single-phase full-bridge inverter and testing of its operation with RL load.
